name: Ichinose Honami
source:
Class: 1-B

The protagonist's underclassman who transferred on the same day, she is serious and polite, not to mention an honor student. She isn't accustomed to living away from her parents, which is why she often feels very lonely. Honami is tad bit tsundere towards people because she doesn't know how to socialize with them. After spending some time with the protagonist, in her mind, he turns from her "senpai" into "a man". She has no knowledge of perverted stuff, and becomes red in the face whenever the topic is brought up.

Cup size: F
